Revisions restore the confirming tag and buyout meaning,impatient challenge and too-late warning,clear contradiction plus rapid depletion,delegation and familiar kinship-free reassurance. Remove unsupported Dad for親父さん. Retain the natural color judgment,But hesitation,rhetorical sellout doubt,both repeated You think? replies,Yes!,Of course! and tentative Dyes/Calicut notice with individual reasons. The source explicitly claims popularity,competitor buyout risk,imminent sellout and strong profit conditional on securing this color. Keep them as the Sailor’s assertions,not narrator-verified stock,prices,guaranteed profit or earned game state. No named pigment,garment,ingredient,recipe,quantity,price,purchase,delivery,kinship,new rank,employment or joint-profit partnership is invented.
